entry.label: Stafford Beer
entry.description: British cybernetician and management thinker who developed the Viable System Model, Team Syntegrity and a practice of organisational cybernetics concerned with managing complexity and preserving operational autonomy.
entry.canonical_definition: Beer's account connects organisational viability with variety in operations, channels, and boundary transducers.
